fluff.overview: Lyran infantry draw confidence from knowing their equipment is first-rate, even when assigned to garrison duty on worlds far from the front lines. Foot infantry platoons form the backbone of the LCAF's garrison forces, deploying on foot to hold positions, patrol perimeters, and secure urban areas where vehicles cannot easily operate. Armed with assault rifles and light anti-aircraft weapons, these platoons provide dedicated point air defense for installations and ground formations against low-flying aerospace fighters and VTOLs.
